answer.label: Attributed to — an improvised film line
answer.sourceLine: Clemenza, played by Richard S. Castellano, says this in The Godfather. Although Francis Ford Coppola and Mario Puzo share the screenplay credit, Coppola has specifically credited Castellano with making up the cannoli line. Coppola’s account on ReelBlend ↗

source.heading: The source
source.excerpt: Leave the gun, take the cannoli
trail: Clemenza, played by Richard S. Castellano, says this in The Godfather. Although Francis Ford Coppola and Mario Puzo share the screenplay credit, Coppola has specifically credited Castellano with making up the cannoli line. Coppola’s account on ReelBlend ↗

Coppola’s account distinguishes the performer’s contribution from the screenplay’s general authorship. ACMI also describes the line as improvised, crediting a suggestion by Castellano’s wife and co-star Ardell Sheridan. Read the supporting source ↗
source.excerptNote: An excerpt of the wording under discussion; see the source and attribution limitations below.
source.rightsNote: The film was released after 1930 and its screen dialogue remains in copyright. Studio rights are separate from the writing or performance credit; no reuse licence is asserted.
